remaining.guard: Do not claim current P*1024 vs initial1024 growable rows are same full/backpressure contract. MAX_SUBQUEUE_SIZE=1024 alone does not fix it: block32 admission can still reject before an exact ring would. Avoid a new external-limit synchronization framework just to force a ranking.
remaining.scope: Wait for a real same-policy trace; no historical multiplier inherited. Producer/consumer tokens and batch APIs must be stated, not silently enabled for only one arm.

timing_and_units: queue_sota MPMC is cold callback scope: local queue, fresh P+C threads, transfer+postcheck, joins and destructor. Producers are launched before consumers without a start barrier; bounded-full retries versus growable progress can diverge during startup.
queue_sota single-thread uses static queues and512 scalar enqueues/pops; batch1024 means1024 individual operations per wave. Moody bulk enqueue/dequeue is not used.

product_v6 unbounded uses precreated queue, warmup, then worker start/finish envelope; thread creation/join, queue construction and final destruction are not in its reported seconds. It reports2*transferred operations, so do not compare its Mops/s directly with ns/transferred-item cold rows.
implementation_conclusion: No new definite asymptotic implementation defect established. Sharded round-robin empty scan O(P) and different peer traversal/registration are real candidate costs once an application trace is aligned; they are not themselves evidence of current slower performance or a reason to erase a future fair loss.

references.meaning: Single-thread queue persists across waves; constructor occurs at first invocation, destructor at process teardown.
Single-thread and owner reference use implicit enqueue and ignore return; doNotOptimizeAway(sum) is not an expected-payload assertion.
P shards each1024, totalP*1024; stable producer index.
Moody current row is growable implicit enqueue; failure is fatal, not bounded full retry.
MPMC denominator is one transferred item (push+pop), not one try operation; batch is only normalization, not a bulk API.
Queue/thread construction, join, conservation and queue destruction are within each MPMC benchmark callback.
Warm worker timing begins at earliest worker start and ends at latest worker finish, excludes construction/join/destruction.
Worker finish envelope; not the cold MPMC episode boundary.
Unbounded historical denominator is individual push or pop, twice the transferred-item count.
Queue constructed before warmup and measurement; destroyed after measurement/output.
SPSC fixture requests CPU affinity but does not validate success.
Hyle is always first; queue allocation and persistent pair creation/destruction are outside timed runner.run.
Peer is local Folly-shaped sentinel code, not compiled Folly; only one worker pair alive at a time.
try_pop/try_consume scan at mostP shards; documented per-shard policy, not a newly proved redundant complexity defect.
Subqueue maximum enforced when advancing blocks; not an exact ring-style full condition after every freed item.
capacity requests initial pool, does not establish fixed usable or no later allocation for multiple producers.
Existing producer-aware preallocation entry, still requires real validation of hot allocations/try failures.
